title: Lithium facilities
description: Every facility in the parent database that produces, refines, recycles or is being explored for lithium, with location and co-product metals.

tiers.A: lithium listed in the facility's commodities[]
tiers.B: lithium in the facility name or aliases (commodities incomplete)
tiers.C: lithium documented only in research/verification notes (vetted)

selection_criteria.excluded: matches where the commodity name appeared only inside a company name; see excluded_review

excluded_review.name: Reps Mine
excluded_review.reason: Copper mine in Albania; note describes Albemarle's Silver Peak (Nevada) lithium site and the province field says 'Nevada' - record looks corrupted.

excluded_review.name: Galaxy Mine
excluded_review.reason: Listed as Gold, but owners (Galaxy Resources / Orocobre) and coordinates near Ravensthorpe WA point to the Mt Cattlin lithium mine.

excluded_review.name: Pertha May Mine
excluded_review.reason: Listed as Gold at Perth CBD coordinates, but companies are the Greenbushes owner set (Talison/Tianqi/Albemarle/IGO). Probable junk record.

excluded_review.name: Becancour Smelter
excluded_review.reason: Aluminium/silicon smelter complex. Nemaska Lithium is one of nine companies listed; Becancour does host a separate Nemaska lithium plant.

excluded_review.name: El Rincon Mine
excluded_review.reason: Listed as Copper in Antofagasta. Rio Tinto's Rincon lithium project is in Salta, Argentina - probable conflation.

excluded_review.name: Huichun Smelter
excluded_review.reason: Copper smelter; note only says companies are 'involved in lithium mining' generically.

excluded_review.name: Xiangyuan Jinxing Coal Mine
excluded_review.reason: Note says Zijin's 'Xiangyuan Hard-Rock Lithium-containing Polymetallic Mine', but commodities say met coal, province says Hunan and coordinates are in Shanxi.

excluded_review.name: Morila Mine
excluded_review.reason: Gold mine. 'Mali Lithium' is a former corporate name of Firefinch, not a commodity.

excluded_review.name: Corridor Sands Projects Development
excluded_review.reason: Heavy mineral sands (Ti/Zr/Hf). 'Sinowin Lithium' is a company name only.
